newsitem.title: UK: UK shares tumble for second day amid Dow jitters.
newsitem.headline: UK shares tumble for second day amid Dow jitters.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index suffered its second consecutive sharp decline on Monday as the latest Wall Street jitters sparked a round of profit-taking in leading British shares.

With banks subject to a severe mark-down after powering the FTSE 100 to a series of record peaks in recent weeks, the index closed 71.5 points lower at 4,805.7 -- making a two-day fall of 143.3 points. Decliners were in a near eight-to-one majority.
Yet dealers were unfazed by the retreat, which came hard on the heels of the FTSE 100 setting a record peak of 4,998.1 in early trade on Friday.
